before.scope: Actual round, fake RPC; deterministic code-unit counts only. No provider or timing measurements.

after.scope: Actual round, fake RPC; deterministic code-unit counts only. No provider or timing measurements.

acceptedChanges: Round now matches the first text-field prefix and decodes incoming characters with incremental state. It retains no accumulated raw JSON prefix. Decoded text is drained on each valid delta instead of re-slicing an accumulated decoded prefix.

Prefix matching against text emitted by earlier StructuredOutput blocks compares each newly decoded segment once. Final structured_output validation, fallback JSON.parse, action separation, native-tool refusal, timeout, listener cleanup and chat abort cleanup remain in place.
Exported partialText is unchanged. Incremental decoding reproduces its trailing raw-backslash and partial unicode-suffix suppression, including suffixes following escaped backslash pairs.

ASCII fixture at 128/256/512 chunks scans exactly 16393/32777/65545 newly received code units and performs zero streaming JSON.parse calls. Old implementation passed 1057024/4211200/16811008 characters through JSON.parse. Counts exclude old regex scans, so do not state full old work totals.

Differential actual old/new round probe uses fixed seed, escaped/raw Unicode, arbitrary splits and three blocks per case. 800 rounds, 1200 blocks, 22407 delta comparisons have identical emitted events and resolved results.
